correctness.rationale: For n>=1, at equal source phase every source prefix contributes height 0 or 1; output height stays in [0,2] and returns to 0. Conversely the height-strip two-letter block transitions can be distributed among the two (01)^n streams with balanced completed-pair counts, proving sufficiency. For opposite phases the even heights are zero and each output block is 01 or 10; the independent intermediate synchronization bits realize any target completed-pair count between the two run-count endpoints, an interval containing n. The strip walk has 2^(2n-1) words, opposite-phase 2^(2n), singleton overlap (01)^(2n), union 3*2^(2n-1)-1. Independently enumerated all masks and distinct output sets for n=1..4 and checked the equality with both specified languages. These bounded checks corroborate the all-n constructive proof.
